question: The average of 7 numbers is 23. If each number is decreased by 7, what will the new average be?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the properties of averages, if every observation is decreased by a constant value, the new average will also decrease by the same value.

Given old average = 23

Decrease in each number = 7

New Average = 23 − 7 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**
